digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 usage threading and sidecar/coverage metrics
propositions: Pass-1 pass functions discard the runner's per-call _usage, so batch outputs and coverage.metrics lack token totals for the most expensive pass.
The three pass functions change return type from list[dict] to (findings, usage_dict), and every in-package and external caller is updated atomically to unpack the new shape.
Usage is recorded per call with a criteria list and token fields; per-criterion llm_calls is derived as the count of call records covering each criterion.
Multi-criterion single-turn chunks divide token fields equally across covered criteria while counting requests and llm_calls in full per criterion.
Checkpoint-resumed chunks and ladder attempts that raise contribute no usage record, while every completed ladder attempt appends its own record.
run_focused_finder is extended to return summed usage over its internal run_bin calls, and the sidecar payload gains coverage.usage.per_call and coverage.usage.per_criterion.
